summary: A rubbish mask and the rubbish drawn with it are built and on the street copy and the lockout shot file (both opened in memory, nothing saved). The mask finds the gutters, the foot of the house walls and steps, doorsteps, rain pipe and lamp post feet, inside corners and the ground round the props from the real 3D geometry (two small 'places pictures'), is broken into natural patches by noise, and never sits on the crown of the road (0.000 over |x| < 1.3 m in the street copy; in the lockout file only the prop rings reach there). It drives a painted muck layer (group RUBBISH, after WETNESS and JOINTS on the road, pavement flags, gutter and kerb stones: coal dust, angular cinders and grit, mud, ash, wet straw, sodden paper, dead leaves as colour, roughness and relief, wet where the street is wet) and a Geometry Nodes scatter of small 3D pieces (6,439 in the street copy, 7,199 in the lockout file; nothing printed, nothing modern). Controls: amount, gutter, wall foot, corners and doorsteps, around props, seed, plus patchiness, three widths, crown clear, six kinds, look and piece dials (24 in all). The setts keep their 3D look: in the street copy's 16 test pictures the joint contrast is identical to two decimals with and without rubbish; 21 of 22 test pictures pass with the rubbish, exactly as before it (the one failure, lockout brazier glare in heavy rain, middle band at 540x960, is the old one). All 9 plate-size pictures pass. The final full-size lockout plate (1536x2730, wet, setts and rubbish, 64 samples) is drawn. Not done: the painter (paid), the glb and stage, Cycles, dirt on the wall surfaces, other files/cameras (the places picture must be made again), anyone's eye but mine.
what_changed: Nothing in set_copy/, tools/, glb/, maps/ or the film project was changed (file dates checked; the lockout file opened read-only, never saved; no git). All new work is in relief_and_rubbish/rubbish/ and the recipe note. NEW LAYER RUBBISH (rubbish/tools/rubbish_layer.py): a shader node group of 547 nodes put in memory after the last layer that feeds the Principled BSDF on four materials: street_setts (after WETNESS then JOINTS), pavement_flags, channel_stones, kerb_stone (after WETNESS). It reads the WETNESS layer's Wet Mask and Puddle Mask. Defaults: Rubbish Amount 1, Gutter 1, Wall Foot 1, Corners And Doorsteps 1, Around Props 1, Seed 0, Patchiness 0.55, Gutter Width 0.45 m, Wall Foot Width 0.75 m, Props Width 0.8 m, Crown Clear 1 (nothing within 1.3 m of the middle line, full from 1.8 m), Dust And Cinders/Ash/Mud/Straw/Paper/Leaves 1 each, Dust Darkness 0.75, Grit Size 1 (cells about 1.8 cm and a second set about 4 cm), Relief 1, Wet Look 1. Layers bottom to top: dust film, mud, ash, cinders, big lumps, grit, straw, paper, leaves; colours and roughness dry to wet are in the note section B4; only surfaces facing up (smoothstep 0.75 to 0.93 of the normal z) are painted; under puddles the dulling and relief are cut by 0.8 x puddle mask; shine cut by up to 55 % and water film by up to 85 % where dust, cinders, ash or straw lie; bump distance 12 mm. MASK: gutter = full on the channel stones (|x| 2.2 to 2.5), falling over Gutter Width on the road side and 0.45 m over the kerb and pavement, kerb top x0.55, times the Crown Clear factor; wall foot = (1 - smoothstep(distance to wall or step, 0, Wall Foot Width))^1.5; corners and doorsteps = doorstep blobs, rain pipe and lamp post feet and inside corners from the places picture; props = (1 - smoothstep(distance to prop, 0, Props Width))^1.3; each broken by its own noise (Patchiness) and a slow house-to-house factor 0.6 to 1.35; combined as 1-(1-a)(1-b)(1-c)(1-d) x Amount. NEW PIECES (rubbish_pieces.py): collections lumps (3 cinder, 2 clinker, sherd, stick), coal (3), ash heaps (3), paper (2 torn, 3 sodden, 1 wad), leaves (3), straw (3 bundles of 2 to 4 strands 1.5 mm thick); Geometry Nodes group RUBBISH PIECES (310 nodes) on a host object: six Poisson scatters (max per m2 70/45/6/16/16/18, min distance 0.05/0.05/0.12/0.09/0.08/0.12 m), density from the same mask terms and dials, only y < 45 m (Pieces Distance), aligned to the ground, random yaw and scale, seed-linked; piece materials go dry to wet with the street wetness. NEW PLACES PICTURES (make_places_pictures.py, 4 cm a dot, 225x2100, x -4.5 to 4.5, y -12 to 72): maps/places_street_a/b.png and places_lockout_a/b.png made from the real geometry (distance to wall, step and plinth, to props (33 objects in the lockout file), doorsteps from the 28 door frames, rain pipe and lamp post feet, inside corners from 12 sideways rays). ONE APPLY SCRIPT: apply_rubbish_to_set.py (apply, set_dials, set_state, pieces, show_mask, remove). Round 2 wetness settings and JOINTS settings (strength 1) are untouched. Also new: picture runner, job writers, measuring script (joint measure with rubbish dots left out), plan numbers, sheets, self-test.
controls: Short name (long name): range, default, what it does. amount (Rubbish Amount) 0-2, 1: master; 0 = ground exactly as before (self-test); share of ground clearly rubbish 17/30/36 % at 0.5/1/2. gutter (Gutter) 0-2, 1: gutter, kerb, road outer strip (alone 18 % of ground). wall_foot (Wall Foot) 0-2, 1: foot of walls and steps (alone 11 %). corners (Corners And Doorsteps) 0-2, 1: doorsteps, rain pipe and lamp post feet, inside corners (alone 5.6 %). props (Around Props) 0-2, 1: rings round props, lockout file only (alone 4.7 %). seed (Seed) any, 0: moves patches and pieces. patchiness (Patchiness) 0-1, 0.55: 0 smooth strips (33 % of ground) to 1 separate heaps (24 %). gutter_width (Gutter Width) 0.05-1.5 m, 0.45. wall_width (Wall Foot Width) 0.1-2 m, 0.75. props_width (Props Width) 0.1-1.5 m, 0.8. crown_clear (Crown Clear) 0-1, 1: 1 = gutter rubbish never nearer the middle line than 1.3 m (with Gutter Width 1.6: 38 % of ground, against 45 % with Crown Clear 0). dust (Dust And Cinders), ash (Ash), mud (Mud), straw (Straw), paper (Paper), leaves (Leaves): 0-2, 1 each: that kind. dust_darkness (Dust Darkness) 0-1, 0.75. grit_size (Grit Size) 0.5-2, 1. relief (Relief) 0-2, 1: 0 = flat paint. wet_look (Wet Look) 0-1, 1: 0 = always dry colours. Pieces: pieces_density (Pieces Density) 0-2, 1 (0 = none); pieces_distance (Pieces Distance) 5-90 m, 45; piece_size (Piece Size) 0.5-2, 1. Python: ar.apply(places='street' or 'lockout', **dials), ar.set_dials(**dials), ar.set_state(wetness), ar.pieces(bool), ar.show_mask('colours' or 'total', raw=True), ar.remove().
